effective_limits_observation.scope: Selected healthy native Docker/cgroup observations during guarded final archival, not a replacement for phase samples. Startup and one-shot process generations recorded separately in run artifacts.

network_lifetime_observation.scope: Docker eth0 lifetime counters since guest container creation, including bootstrap, both qualification attempts, native archive/control SSH and health checks. Not a per-phase/client-only rate; removed one-shot runner network counters unavailable.

post_promotion_fencing.scope: Independent healthy native listings after promotion and before teardown. Source pool is absent; target owns the imported pool. Administrative export, not quorum-enforced or power fencing.

controller_exclusion.scope: Controlled independent host-process test against the actual state/controller.lock file. Does not claim cross-container/NFS locking. Earlier after-teardown status attempt remains explicitly inconclusive.

auxiliary_inconclusive_attempt.reason: The teardown handle completed before this auxiliary status/exclusion probe ran. The probe acquired the now-free host lock then failed at a read-only Docker listing because the filesystem sandbox blocked socket access. No Docker mutation occurred; original controller-exclusion.json and empty run directory retained here for provenance.

earlier_failed_attempt.failure: Native archive checker incorrectly required balanced BEGIN/END counts for recursive compound package; source stayed fenced and intact. Retained stream rechecked against pinned source semantics and actual native output.
earlier_failed_attempt.reuse: Same already-provisioned owned guests and native versions; new independent full serial qualification, no reboot or hidden failed-case reset. Native archive guard must pass before any pool recycling.
